title: Phoenix Finserv
description: Phoenix Finserv is a modern financial services platform featuring multiple service modules and detailed sub-service categories, including Protection, Mortgage, Commercial Lending, Pensions, and Estate Planning. The website includes dynamic dropdown navigation, responsive UI sections, reusable components, and interactive business-focused layouts built with React.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.

title: Hotel Booking Engine
description: A MERN Stack hotel booking system with role-based access (Admin, Hotel Master, Manager). Hotel Masters manage hotel profiles, amenities, room types, and date-wise pricing. The booking module checks availability, validates dates, calculates totals, and stores customer details.

title: E-Commerce - Shivam Chains & Charms
description: Full-stack e-commerce application with user authentication, product management, shopping cart, and Razorpay payment integration.

title: Pizza Ordering System
description: Pizza ordering e-commerce app with menu browsing, cart, and a secure Stripe payment gateway. Includes an admin dashboard with authentication for order management and tracking.

title: Travel Management / Reimbursement
description: Travel Management System where employees submit travel forms for HOD approval and manage trip details. Reimbursement flow with real-time HOD status updates streamlines approvals and claim handling.

title: Bookstore
description: Bookstore application with role-based login for buyers, sellers, and admins. Browse, search, add, remove, and purchase books through a seamless e-commerce experience with secure checkout.
